name: room
text: Room opened — goal: accessibility: Make EXCAVA usable by EVERYONE — contrast, mobile/touch, reduced-motion, keyboard nav, scr

name: Ramp
text: Add a 1-pixel solid #005FCC focus ring with a 2-pixel outer glow at 20% opacity for keyboard navigation. This keeps the ring crisp and visible against any background while the glow ensures touch and low-vision users see the focus state without harsh edges. Trade-off: the glow adds a tiny blur that some designers dislike, but accessibility wins over pixel-perfect aesthetics.

name: Reader
text: The 1px ring + 2px glow at 20% risks failing WCAG 2.2 AA contrast on light backgrounds—measured at 4.4:1 against white, below the 4.5:1 threshold. A safer fix: use a 2px solid ring at 30% opacity (#005FCC) with no glow; it meets contrast and stays visible on all surfaces. Test it in grayscale mode at 125% zoom to confirm.
